altText: A male Northern Cardinal perched on a bare branch, scarlet all over with a pointed crest and a black mask around his thick orange bill.
A male Northern Cardinal landing on a branch with wings and tail spread, showing how red he is underneath.
A female Northern Cardinal in falling snow, warm buff-brown with an orange bill and the same pointed crest as the male.
A female Northern Cardinal standing on snow, showing her whole body, brown with reddish wings and tail.
